_comment: Empty by default. Copy to config.json, then fill exactly what you intend to enable. Nothing here is auto-discovered and no value is read from the environment.

_notes.identity: holder_id must be an explicitly issued uuid4 from the executor. A mailbox, alias, message id, thread id, directory name, window title, or 'most recently active' value is not an identity and will be rejected.
_notes.no_persistent_access: This package never writes a token, cookie, credential, or reusable access grant anywhere.
_notes.network_double_gate: An adapter fires only if adapters.<name>.enabled is true AND allow_network is true AND its own settings are non-empty; otherwise it raises NetworkDisabledError with a named reason.
